result_text:
I fixed the pattern typos in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`. The `codeanalyzer` tests pass. I didn't add new tests for the `.htm`, `.xml` and `-gradle.js` cases, so I haven't checked those matches directly.

- **HTML generators:** the pkgdown, Doxygen and `<meta name="generator">` rules had `(html|html|xhtml)`. They are now `(html|htm|xhtml)`, so `.htm` pages match and `.html` and `.xhtml` still do.
- **`<doc>` XML and `// Generated by` JS:** the path patterns `.*/[.]xml` and `.*/[.]js` only matched a file literally named `.xml` or `.js`. They are now `.*[.]xml` and `.*[.]js`. The content conditions are unchanged, so ordinary `.xml` and `.js` files still stay out of the generated scope.
- **Gradle JS:** `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` lands in build-and-deployment. The `.*[.]gradle` rule that covers `build.gradle` is untouched.
